programs.base_parameter: Choose any even m0>=4 before any comparison model is opened.
programs.choice_independence: Any two finite chains of uniform subdivisions have a common uniform refinement indexed by a common multiple; naturality makes the transported half-role agree there.
programs.counterexample_to_unrestricted_independe: M4_NONUNIFORM_REFINEMENT_PARITY_LOSS: C4 -> C5 by subdividing one edge destroys existence.
programs.different_role_limit_equality: No equality with R2/R3/R4/R5 is asserted at Stage E because no common carrier/readout is frozen.
programs.exact_recursion_naturality: h_s ∘ i_{r,s} = i_{r,s} ∘ h_r for every r|s.
programs.existence: Every m0*r is even, so h_r exists at every stage.
programs.objects: For each positive integer r, P_r is an oriented polygonal 2-cell with boundary B_r=Z/(m0*r)Z and successor s_r(j)=j+1.
programs.proof: For s=k r: h_s(i(j))=k j + m0 k r/2 = k(j+m0 r/2)=i(h_r(j)).
programs.refinement_map: If s=k*r, i_{r,s}(j)=k*j mod (m0*s). This is the uniform k-fold subdivision embedding of old boundary vertices.
programs.refinement_path_dependence: Absent inside the declared uniform-subdivision directed system; present for unrestricted cellular subdivision.
programs.stabilization_convergence: No numeric convergence is asserted. The compatible family {h_r} induces a unique involution h_infty on the algebraic direct limit colim_r B_r.

theorem_vs_computation.bounded_exact_checks: The companion checker enumerates multiple even base sizes and uniform refinement factors, verifies permutation involution/uniqueness/naturality, and verifies explicit S3 deletion witnesses.
theorems: R1 exists iff a finite boundary cycle has even cardinality.
Uniform subdivision embeddings commute exactly with R1.
The directed system therefore has an exact algebraic direct-limit involution.
Unrestricted subdivision does not preserve R1.
